# picotls (vendored subset)

TLS 1.3 core used by picoquic. Upstream:
https://github.com/h2o/picotls — MIT license (no LICENSE file upstream;
the TLS protocol implementation is MIT per the upstream README).

- Version: master `588f7dcb` (2026-10)
- Subset: `include/picotls.h`, `include/picotls/*`, `lib/picotls.c`
  (TLS 1.3 core), `lib/pembase64.c` (PEM parsing), `lib/asn1.c`
  (certificate parsing), `lib/hpke.c` (HPKE for ECH; referenced
  unconditionally by `picotls.c`/`ech.c`).
- Deliberately excluded: `lib/openssl.c`, `lib/cifra.c`, `lib/uecc.c`,
  `lib/fusion.c`, `lib/minicrypto-pem.c`, `lib/mbedtls.c`,
  `lib/mbedtls_sign.c` (Murmur uses picoquic's own mbedTLS glue in
  `deps/picoquic/picoquic_mbedtls/` instead), `lib/ffx.c`,
  `lib/certificate_compression.c`, `lib/ptlsbcrypt.c`.

## Build

Per-file shims in `clients/go/bindings/picoquic/qp_tls_*.c`, generated by
`clients/go/tools/gen_pq_shims.sh` (see `deps/picoquic/README.md`).

## Updating

1. Download the new picotls tarball.
2. Replace `include/` and the vendored `lib/*.c` files.
3. Regenerate shims, rebuild, run the loopback smoke test (N1 gate).
4. Update the version line above.
